notes.title: Grape Juice City - Open Beta Steam Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954453/32010aaf145ba6409109783cc6edebb826159b3c.png[/img]

After a successful in-person launch last night, we've decided to release Grape Juice City to the public in an open beta state. We're looking for feedback specifically on balancing between abilities, powerups, and item respawn rates, but are open to everything our players want to share with us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954453/cd2601fc2a10ea2851374cab6025d1b2683fd5d6.png[/img]

The game is currently stable for between 1 and 3 players. We're already working out some bugs that prevent playing with a full 4 person lobby, but decided not to delay release when the game is otherwise functional.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954453/eecffcc308d544180fce73614a6b1705a64a3835.png[/img]

Thank you to everyone who came to Stout Game Expo and player our game. We were honored to receive the Audience Choice and Best Gameplay awards in our category. As we move into future development we hope to respond to the feedback of our players so we can live up to those awards to the fullest.

Feedback will be accepted in the form of Reviews, Comments, or you can email us directly at GrapeJuiceCityGame@gmail.com. We're looking forward to hearing from you!

All that said, the game is now open to play.
Have fun, and good luck Juicers!
